reply_text:
I told Hollis in his #central-team thread that the deadline is 3 April. Pree first posted 25 August in #central-team on 14 Oct. Later that day she corrected it in #central-random to 3 April, saying she'd read the wrong line. Hollis is in both channels, so he could already see both messages.

She didn't give a year for either date, so I asked Hollis to check the year with her before he updates the account sheet.

The brain still holds both dates. I tried to delete the 25 August entry, but the brain said that entry doesn't exist, even though it still shows up when I look it up. The 3 April entry says it replaces 25 August. Until someone removes the old one, a search could still bring up 25 August.
